RAJYA   SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the May 15, 2002/Vaisakha 25, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
213
Modernisation of Police
*701. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have granted/
sanctioned financial assistance to the
Haryana Government for modernisation
of police force and purchase of
sophisticated equipments;
(b) if so, what are the details of funds
released during the last two years;
(c) whether State Government has
utilized the funds for the said purpose and
if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) what steps are being taken by
Government to ensure that the funds
granted/sanctioned are utilized for the
purpose they were given, by the Haryana
Government?
Cases against Delhi
Police officials
*702. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of Delhi Police officials
facing enquiries in corruption cases;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the number of policemen punished
for corrupt acts during the last two years;
(c) whether policemen are imparted
refresher courses/training periodically to
make them public-friendly; if so, the
details of such courses; and
(d) the forum set up to redress the
grievances of the policemen?
Integrated Wasteland Development
Programme
†*703. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the proposals received by
Government during the last one year from
Government of Chhattisgarh under Swarn
Jayanti Gram Swarojgar Yojana and
Integrated Wasteland Development
Programme;
(b) the funds demanded by the State
Government for the same and the funds
sanctioned by Government; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure timely completion of all schemes?

WIN2\SESSION\912RS-QUES 214
Milk supplier to Goa unit of Indian
Navy
*704. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Goa unit of
Indian Navy has rejected tender of ASC
supplier for supply of milk and accepted
tender of a Solapur based supplier;
(b) whether it is also a fact that ASC
contractor has been supplying fresh milk
procured from Belgaum based cooperative
for the last several years and he was issued
a certificate for satisfactory service;
(c) whether Solapur based supplier is
supplying preserved milk at higher cost
which reaches Goa after 3-4 days of its
procurement which is dangerous for
health; and
(d) the reasons for rejecting tender of
ASC contractor and accepting tender of
Solapur based supplier situated 500 km.
away from Goa?
Power Plants of  Neyveli Lignite
Corporation in Tamil Nadu
*705. SHRI S.S. CHANDRAN: Will
the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) the power generation capacity of
the Thermal Power Plants of Neyveli
Lignite Corporation in Tamil Nadu;
(b) the details of distribution of power,
State-wise;
(c) the likely increase of power
generation in the near future;
(d) whether the increased power
generation will be shared among other
States in addition to Tamil Nadu; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Financial assistance to power projects
*706. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Power Finance
Corporation propose to provide Rs. 43,500
crore for power projects; during the Tenth
Plan;
(b) if so, whether during the Ninth
Plan, the Power Finance Corporation
disbursed loans worth Rs. 16,525 crore as
against the target of Rs. 17,000 crore;
(c) if so, what were the reasons for not
disbursing loans as targeted;
(d) whether the Corporation is also
considering to extend financial assistance
to equipment manufacturers in the power
sector; and
(e) if so, whether details about the
modus of raising requisite resources have
been finalised?
Weekly monitoring of working of
power projects
*707. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
emphasised and urged upon the State
Governments and its undertakings in
power sector to monitor the progress of
work on weekly basis of all ongoing power
projects;
(b) if so, the reaction of the State
Governments and its undertakings in this
regard;
(c) whether Government's advice is
being acted upon; and
(d) the States which are showing laxity
in this regard?

Watershed programmes in Andhra
Pradesh
*708. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
implementing major watershed
development programmes in Andhra
Pradesh to contain the declining water
levels in the rural parts of the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether village ponds have also
been constructed in the State under these
programmes; and
(d) if so, the details thereo

Induction of IBM Agni-II
5103. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to induct IBM Agni-II as part of Army
arsenal;
(b) whether the Army is raising a new
missile regiment to operationally manage
the nuclear deterrent; and
(c) the pay load of the weapon and when
the next deterrent with more strike range
would be developed and included in the
army arsenal?
Fire in HEMRL, Pune
5104. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that fire had broken
out at the chemical processing unit of High
Energy Materials Research Laboratory at
Pasan near Pune on 25th April, 2002;
(b) if so, the loss suffered in terms of
life and equipment etc.;
(c) whether an enquiry has been held in
the matter; and
(d) the details of steps taken on the
conclusion of enquiry?
Contract with Israel for conversion of
Boeing 737
5105. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that HAL had tied
up with Israel to convert Boeing 737
passenger jets into cargo aircraft;
(b) if so, the terms and conditions of the
contract;
(c) in what manner this contract would
help the country; and
(d) the other contracts that are in the
offing?
Demands raised by Association of
AFHQ Stenographers
5106. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
demands/issues have been raised by the
Association of AFHQ Stenographers; and
(b) if so, the details of letters received
during the last two years and action taken
thereon?

Development of modified version of
MBT Arjuna
5107. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Tank Arjuna has not been found very much
suited to the varied requirements of the
Indian Army for operations in different
terrains;
(b) if so, whether any modified version
of this tank or alternative artillery guns
namely Karna and Bheem have been or are
being developed; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Induction of AJT
5108. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the frequency
of MIG crashes has established the need
for early induction of an Advanced Jet
Trainer (AJT); and
(b) if so, what steps have been and are
being taken for expediting acquisition of an
AJT and at what stage the acquisition process
stands at present?
Missing MIG 21 aircraft
5109. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an Indian Air
Force MIG-21 aircraft went missing after
taking off from Tejpur Air Base on
20th April, 2002;
(b) if so, whether its wreckage was not
found even after 10 days;
(c) whether India has sought Bhutan's
assistance in locating its wreckage in Bhutan;
(d) the number of persons at the time of
flight in the aircraft; and
(e) the other details in this regard?
The US assistance in India's military
needs
5110. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the U.S. is assisting in
India's military needs; and
(b) if so, the details of the proposed sale
by the U.S. to improve the security of the
country?
Joint arms manufacturing partnership
with South Africa
5111. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that South Africa
has proposed a Joint Arms Manufacturing
partnership with India;
(b) if so, whether the proposal involves
transfer of technology to India and export
of manufactured arms to other countries;
and
(c) if so, what is India response to this
offer?
Military exercises by Pakistan close to
LoC in PoK
5112. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Pakistan have
conducted Military Exercise in the month
of March, 2002 close to the Line of Control
in Pak occupied Kashmir;
(b) if so, whether Government of India
was informed in advance about this;

any protest with the Pakistan Government
in this regard; and
(d) the other details in this regard?
Proposed strike by civilian employees
of Ordnance Factories
5113. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that civilian
employees of Ordnance Factories propose
to go on strike;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
